title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Casebook: Merchant Acknowledgement Uplift
content:
**Rule.** This rule covers the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card. For the credit given on filing on an incorrect-amount dispute of a single-use virtual card purchase, the merchant acknowledgement uplift depends on the merchant credits posted on the single-use card:

- when those credits total at least 5.00, the uplift is 5.00;
- when they total more than 0.00, but less than 5.00, the uplift is 2.00;
- when the merchant has posted no credit, the uplift is 0.00.

Every merchant credit posted on the single-use card counts towards the total, whether or not it is linked to the purchase.

### Cases (hypothetical credits)

| Merchant credits posted on the single-use card | Total | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| 3.00 and 2.00 | 5.00 | 5.00, because 5.00 is at least 5.00 |
| 12.00 | 12.00 | 5.00 |
| 4.99 | 4.99 | 2.00 |
| 0.01 | 0.01 | 2.00 |
| none | 0.00 | 0.00 |
